sentences.en: Now that we've done all the research into bike-sharing schemes in cities around the world, we need to think about how we're going to organise our report
sentences.zh: 现在，我们已经完成了对全球各大城市共享单车计划的研究，接下来需要考虑如何组织我们的报告。

sentences.en: Right
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I think we should start by talking about the benefits
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该先谈谈其益处。

sentences.en: I mean it's great that so many cities have introduced these schemes where anyone can pick up a bike from dozens of different locations and hire it for a few hours
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，许多城市都推出了这类计划，人们可以在数十个不同地点随时取用自行车，并租用数小时，这非常棒。

sentences.en: It makes riding a bike very convenient for people
sentences.zh: 这使得骑自行车对人们而言变得极为便利。

sentences.en: Yes, but the costs can add up and that puts people on low incomes off in some places
sentences.zh: 是的，但费用累积起来可能很高，因此在某些地方，低收入人群会因此却步。

sentences.en: I suppose so, but if it means more people in general are cycling rather than driving, then because they're increasing the amount of physical activity they do, it's good for their health
sentences.zh: 我想确实如此，但如果这意味着总体上有更多人选择骑车而非开车，那么由于他们增加了身体活动量，这对健康是有益的。

sentences.en: OK
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But isn't that of less importance?
sentences.zh: 但那难道不是重要性较低的方面吗？

sentences.en: I mean, doesn't the impact of reduced emissions on air pollution have a more significant effect on people's health?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，减少排放对空气污染的影响，难道不会对人们的健康产生更显著的作用吗？

sentences.en: / JAKE： Certainly, in some cities bike-sharing has made a big contribution to that
sentences.zh: / JAKE： 脚本 当然，在一些城市，共享单车计划对此已作出了巨大贡献。

sentences.en: And also helped to cut the number of cars on the road significantly
sentences.zh: 同时也有助于大幅减少道路上的汽车数量。

sentences.en: Which is the main point
sentences.zh: 这才是关键所在。

sentences.en: Exactly
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: But I'd say it's had less of an impact on noise pollution because there are still loads of buses and lorries around
sentences.zh: 但我认为，它对噪音污染的影响较小，因为周围仍有大量公交车和卡车。

sentences.en: Right
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Shall we quickly discuss the recommendations we're going to make?
sentences.zh: 我们是否快速讨论一下我们即将提出的建议？

sentences.en: In order to ensure bike-sharing schemes are successful?
sentences.zh: 以确保共享单车计划取得成功？

sentences.en: Yes
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: OK
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, while I think it's nice to have really state-of-the art bikes with things like GPS, I wouldn't say they're absolutely necessary
sentences.zh: 嗯，虽然我认为配备GPS等尖端技术的自行车确实很棒，但我并不认为它们是绝对必需的。

sentences.en: But some technical things are really important- like a fully functional app- so people can make payments and book bikes easily
sentences.zh: 但某些技术要素确实非常重要——比如功能完备的应用程序——以便人们能轻松完成付款和预订自行车。

sentences.en: Places which haven't invested in that have really struggled
sentences.zh: 那些未在这方面投入的城市，运营上确实遇到了很大困难。

sentences.en: Good point
sentences.zh: 说得很好……

sentences.en: Some people say there shouldn't be competing companies offering separate bike-sharing schemes, but in some really big cities, competition's beneficial and anyway one company might not be able to manage the whole thing
sentences.zh: 有些人认为，不应有相互竞争的公司各自推出独立的共享单车计划；但在一些超大城市中，竞争反而有益，而且单家公司可能根本无法承担整个运营任务。

sentences.en: Right
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Deciding how much to invest is a big question
sentences.zh: 决定投资多少是个重大问题。

sentences.en: Cities which have opened loads of new bike lanes at the same time as introducing bike-sharing schemes have generally been more successful- but there are examples of successful schemes where this hasn't happened
sentences.zh: 那些在推出共享单车计划的同时新建大量自行车道的城市，通常更为成功；但也存在一些成功案例，其中并未同步建设新自行车道……

sentences.en: What does matter though- is having a / big publicity campaign
sentences.zh: 不过真正重要的——是开展大规模的宣传推广活动。

sentences.en: Definitely
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: If people don't know how to use the scheme or don't understand its benefits, they won't use it
sentences.zh: 如果人们不了解如何使用该计划，或不清楚其益处，就不会去使用它。

sentences.en: People need a lot of persuasion to stop using their cars
sentences.zh: 要让人们放弃开车，需要大量的说服工作。

sentences.en: AMY： / JAKE： AMY： JAKE： AMY： JAKE： AMY： JAKE： / AMY： JAKE： AMY： JAKE： Shall we look at some examples now?
sentences.zh: AMY： / JAKE： AMY： JAKE： AMY： JAKE： AMY： JAKE： / AMY： JAKE： AMY： JAKE： 我们现在是否该看看一些具体案例了？

sentences.en: And say what we think is good or bad about them
sentences.zh: 并指出我们认为其中哪些做得好、哪些有待改进。

sentences.en: I suppose we should start with Amsterdam as this was one of the first cities to have a bike-sharing scheme
sentences.zh: 我想我们应从阿姆斯特丹开始，因为它是最早推出共享单车计划的城市之一。

sentences.en: Yes
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There was already a strong culture of cycling here
sentences.zh: 这里原本就拥有浓厚的骑行文化。

sentences.en: In a way it's strange that there was such a demand for bike-sharing because you'd have thought most people would have used their own bikes
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，对共享单车需求如此之高显得有些奇怪，因为人们本应大多使用自己的自行车。

sentences.en: And vet it's one of the best-used schemes
sentences.zh: 而它恰恰是使用率最高的计划之一……

sentences.en: Dublin's an interesting example of a success story
sentences.zh: 都柏林则是一个成功的有趣范例。

sentences.en: It must be because the public transport svstem's quite limited
sentences.zh: 一定是由于公共交通系统相当有限。

sentences.en: Not really 一there's no underground, but there are trams and a good bus network
sentences.zh: 其实并非如此——这里没有地铁，但有电车和良好的公交网络。

sentences.en: I'd sav price has a lot to do with it
sentences.zh: 我想价格在其中起了很大作用。

sentences.en: It's one of the cheapest schemes in Europe to join
sentences.zh: 这是欧洲加入费用最低的方案之一。

sentences.en: But the buses are really slow 一anyway the weather certainly can't be a factor!
sentences.zh: 但公交车确实很慢——再说天气肯定不是影响因素！

sentences.en: No- definitely not
sentences.zh: 不——绝对不是。

sentences.en: The London scheme's been quite successful
sentences.zh: 伦敦的自行车租赁计划相当成功。

sentences.en: Yes- it's been a really good thing for the city
sentences.zh: 是的——这对城市来说是一件非常好的事情。

sentences.en: The bikes are popular and the whole system is well maintained but it isn't expanding quickly enough
sentences.zh: 自行车很受欢迎，整个系统也维护得很好，但扩展速度还不够快。

sentences.en: Basically, not enough's been spent on increasing the number of cycle lanes
sentences.zh: 基本上，用于增加自行车道数量的资金投入不足。

sentences.en: Hopefully that'll change
sentences.zh: 希望这种情况会有所改变。

sentences.en: Yes
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now what about outside Europe?
sentences.zh: 那么欧洲以外的情况如何？

sentences.en: Well bike-sharing schemes have taken off in places like Buenos Aires
sentences.zh: 嗯，共享单车计划在布宜诺斯艾利斯等地迅速发展起来。

sentences.en: Mmm
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They built a huge network of cycle lanes to support the introduction of the scheme there, didn't they?
sentences.zh: 他们在那里为配合该计划的推出而建设了庞大的自行车道网络，对吗？

sentences.en: It attracted huge numbers of cyclists where previously there were hardly any
sentences.zh: 这吸引了大量骑行者，而此前那里几乎没有什么骑行者。

sentences.en: An example of good planning
sentences.zh: 这是良好规划的一个范例。
